deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is a membership roster of the Königliche Societät der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen, headed 'Societät 1840 Anfang Mai' (the Society as of early May 1840). Gauss later added death crosses and new names up to 1846.

The layout is as follows:

(1) Top block, 'Ehrenmitglieder' (honorary members), with year of election: Repnin, v. Vietinghoff, Rzewusky (all 1810), Stratimirović (1817), Prinz von Wied (1826), Wedekind (1837, with an unfinished death date '†184..') and v. Lindenau (1837).

(2) Below, three columns, one for each class of the Society:
- **Left column: the physical class** (natural sciences and medicine). Resident ordinary members come first: Hausmann, Langenbeck, Conradi, Marx, v. Siebold, Wöhler, Berthold. Then the external or correspondent members: Stieglitz, Paykull, v. Humboldt, Gadolin, Geoffroy St-Hilaire, Berzelius, Oersted, Lichtenstein, Gay-Lussac, Thenard, Buch, Brongniart, Jörg and others. 'Karsten' is a later addition.
- **Middle column: the mathematical class.** Gauss (1807) and Weber (1831) are the resident members; a rule is drawn under Weber. Then come v. d. Decken (†1840), Krusenstern (†24 Aug 1846), Beautemps-Beaupré, Bessel (†17 March 1846), Brewster, Encke, Fuss, Arago, Schumacher, Struve, Faraday and Plana. Later additions are Herschel (1840), Jacobi (1840), Cauchy (1841), Dirichlet (1846) and Leverrier (1846).
- **Right column: the historical-philological class.** Heeren (†1842), K. O. Müller (†1840), Benecke and Ritter (1840) are resident, then Arnswaldt, Stralenheim and Pertz. The external members are Degérando, Stapfer, Oriola (†29 Apr 1846), Gråberg af Hemsö, Welcker, Uvarov, Raoul-Rochette, the two Grimms, Böckh, Frähn, Dahlmann, Ewald, Bekker, Gerhard, Thiersch, Hase and Kopitar (†11 Aug 1844). Pertz, Guizot and Creuzer are added at the bottom.

The annotations show the list was kept up to date until at least August 1846. It sits among Gauss's personal memoranda: Göttingen police and student statistics on the previous page, and lens achromatism plus a Goethe–Eckermann quotation on the next. There is no derivation to reconstruct.
errors: No mathematical content, so no mathematical errors.
The death dates I can check agree with standard biographies: Bessel 17 March 1846, Krusenstern 24 August 1846 (N.S.), Heeren 1842, K. O. Müller 1840, Kopitar 11 August 1844.
Wedekind's death year is left incomplete ('†184..').

results.what: Roster of members of the Göttingen Society of Sciences (May 1840, annotated to 1846), arranged by class, with election years and death dates

deep.surprise_reason: This is a purely administrative list of Academy members, written by Gauss as a member and secretary-level participant of the Göttingen Society. It contains no mathematical or scientific results.

checkable.asserts: The list, headed May 1840, was annotated over about six years: additions such as Dirichlet and Leverrier in 1846, and deaths up to August 1846 (trivial consistency check; no mathematics on the page).

transcription_corrections: 'Perz' should be Pertz (the name is also added as 'Pertz' lower down).
'Fuss': the image reads 'Fiss/Fuss', i.e. P. H. Fuss.
For von Decken's death, the image appears to read '†1840 Mai 22' rather than 'März 22'.
The page lists both 'Gerhard' and 'Gerhard'; the transcription's 'Gerhard' is fine.
'Gauss' is written in Gauss's own form 'Gauß'.
